Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
def kmp_find(text, pattern):
    if pattern=="": return 0
    lps=[0]*len(pattern); length=0; i=1
    while i<len(pattern):
        if pattern[i]==pattern[length]: length+=1; lps[i]=length; i+=1
        elif length: length=lps[length-1]
        else: i+=1
    i=j=0
    while i<len(text):
        if text[i]==pattern[j]: i+=1; j+=1
        if j==len(pattern): return i-j
        if i<len(text) and text[i]!=pattern[j]:
            if j: j=lps[j-1]
            else: i+=1
    return -1

assert kmp_find("ababcabcabababd","ababd")==10
assert kmp_find("abc","z")==-1
```
explanation: KMP preprocesses the longest-prefix-suffix table then scans without backing up the text pointer. O(n+m) time and O(m) space.
